archetype: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST with Old Money Tech elements

headings.instruction: Import via CDN or Google Fonts if unavailable. Must use tracking-tight for all headings. Never center-align by default.

body.instruction: Clean, crisp geometric sans for readability in financial contexts.

mono.instruction: Use for tickers, numbers, and stats to give a premium technical feel.

rules: Never use pure black or pure white. Always tint slightly.
Green is strictly reserved for positive financial numbers/charts.
Orange is for primary CTAs and highlights.
Dark sections (Navy/Charcoal) should be used for the 'Platform Preview' and 'Final CTA' to create high contrast.

grids.features: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris Grid). Mix spans (col-span-12, col-span-8, col-span-4) to create asymmetry and tension.
grids.stats: grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-8 with vertical dividers (border-r) on desktop.
grids.pricing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8. Center card is 'MOST POPULAR' and slightly scaled up with orange accent border.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary buttons use orange background, text-white, hover:brightness-110, active:scale-95 transition-transform. Secondary buttons are border border-foreground/10 hover:bg-foreground/5.
components.cards: Subtle roundness (rounded-2xl). Flat, rectangular, 1px subtle border (border-border), no shadow by default. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow (shadow-xl).
components.navbar: Glassmorphism: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-b border-border/40. Links visible on desktop, mobile hamburger.
components.accordion: Use Shadcn Accordion for FAQ. Minimalist borders, no background, plus/minus icon indicators.

sections_blueprint.name: Navbar
features: Logo
Links: Home, Services, How It Works, Features, Pricing, About Us, Contact
Login / Get Started CTAs
Sticky Glassmorphism

sections_blueprint.name: Hero
features: Badge: 'NEXT-GEN TRADING TECHNOLOGY' (Mono font, uppercase, tracking-widest, green accent dot)
Heading: 'Trade Smarter With Powerful Automation' (Masked line-by-line text reveal animation)
CTAs: Get Started (Orange), View Demo (Ghost)
Visual: Futuristic trading dashboard mockup (CSS/SVG based or Shadcn Recharts, abstract UI) with fictional data (Portfolio value, P&L in green, charts) floating on a subtle grid background.
Elements: Glowing/floating data pills using framer-motion.

sections_blueprint.name: Marquee / Stats
features: Animated Counters using framer-motion useInView.
Stats: 10K+ Active Users, ₹50Cr+ Trading Volume, 99.9% Uptime, 24/7 Monitoring
Large typography with JetBrains Mono.

sections_blueprint.name: Services
features: 6 Service Cards in an asymmetrical Bento Grid.
Trading Automation, Broker Connectivity, Portfolio Tools, Market Insights, Risk Management, API Access.

sections_blueprint.name: How It Works
features: 3-step process. Minimalist connecting lines between steps.

sections_blueprint.name: Platform Preview
features: Heading: 'One Platform. Complete Trading Control.'
Split section: Text on left, complex interactive dashboard mock on right.
Mockup uses charts (Recharts) showing performance analytics, buy/sell indicators in green/red.
Glowing ambient shadow behind the mockup.

sections_blueprint.name: Pricing
features: Middle card elevated, highlighted with Orange.

sections_blueprint.name: Testimonials
features: 3 cards, offset grid layout.

sections_blueprint.name: FAQ
features: Accordion layout, clean typography.

sections_blueprint.name: Final CTA
features: Massive text, abstract background texture, Orange CTA button.

sections_blueprint.name: Footer
features: Links, Risk Disclaimer (small text), copyright.

motion.scroll_reveal: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 40 }} whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-100px' }} transition={{ duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
motion.floating_elements: animate={{ y: [0, -10, 0] }} transition={{ repeat: Infinity, duration: 4, ease: 'easeInOut' }}

instructions_to_main_agent: You must build a cohesive landing page using the exact fonts, color palette, and component styles specified.
DO NOT use generic centered alignments. Favor left alignment and asymmetrical grids.
The Hero Section dashboard mockup must be built using Shadcn Recharts or CSS/SVG graphics, not images.
All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (e.g. data-testid='pricing-cta-button').
Install and use 'lucide-react' or 'phosphor-icons' for iconography.
Ensure the Indian Rupee (₹) symbol is used exactly where specified.
Avoid the 'AI slop' look. No basic gradients. Use 1px borders, subtle noise/texture where applicable, and generous padding.
No fully transparent backgrounds in sticky navbars or dropdowns.
